data.name: Manzar
data.gender_notes: Manzar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Refers to a scene or a view in Persian culture. The name Manzar carries the meaning “View, Scene” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Manzar usually hope their child will grow to embody view, scene and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Manzar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “View, Scene.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manzar total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: منظر
in_arabic.meaning: مشهد، منظر، أو رؤية، مكان للنظر
in_arabic.long_meaning: منظر هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ن-ظ-ر' والذي يعني النظر أو الرؤية. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم 'منظر' لوصف المشهد أو المنظر الجميل الذي يُنظر إليه. في القرآن الكريم، يُذكر مفهوم النظر والرؤية في عدة آيات، مما يعطي هذا الاسم عمقًا دينيًا وروحانيًا. تاريخيًا، كان استخدام هذا الاسم شائعًا في الثقافة العربية الإسلامية لوصف الأماكن أو الأشياء التي تُنظر إليها ب admiration أو تقدير.

in_urdu.name: منظر
in_urdu.long_meaning: منظر ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ن-ظ-ر' جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے دیکھنا یا نظر اندازی۔ اردو میں، 'منظر' کا استعمال کسی خوبصورت یا قابل دید منظر یا مقام کو بیان کرنے کے لیے کیا جاتا ہے۔ قرآنی حوالے سے، نظر اور رؤية کے تصورات کئی آیات میں ذکر کیے گئے ہیں، جو اس نام کو روحانی اور دینی اہمیت دیتے ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان روایت میں، یہ نام تاریخی طور پر ان مقامات یا چیزوں کو بیان کرنے کے لیے استعمال کیا گیا ہے جنہیں احترام یا تعریف کے ساتھ دیکھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मंज़र
in_hindi.long_meaning: मंज़र एक अरबी नाम है जो 'न-ज़-र' मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है देखना या दृष्टि। हिंदी में, 'मंज़र' का उपयोग किसी सुंदर या आकर्षक दृश्य या स्थान को वर्णित करने के लिए किया जाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम ऐतिहासिक रूप से उन स्थानों या चीजों को वर्णित करने के लिए उपयोग किया गया है जिन्हें सम्मान या प्रशंसा के साथ देखा जाता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रचलित है, जहां यह एक सकारात्मक और उत्थानकारी अर्थ रखता है।

in_pashto.name: منظر
in_pashto.long_meaning: منظر د عربي نوم څخه اخستل شوی دی، چي د 'ن-ظ-ر' ريښې څخه جوړ شوی دی، مانا يې د ليدو یا نظر اندازی. په پښتو کې، 'منظر' د يو ښکلي يا د پام وړ منظر يا ځای د بيانولو لپاره کارول کیږي. د افغانستان او پښتونستان په روایت کې، دا نوم تاريخي پلوه د هغو ځايونو يا شیانو د بيانولو لپاره کارول شوی دی چي د احترام يا ستاينې سره ليدل کیږي.

in_english.name: Manzar
in_english.meaning: a view, scene, or spectacle; a place to look at
in_english.long_meaning: Manzar is an Arabic-originated name derived from the root 'n-ẓ-r', meaning to see or look. In Islamic tradition, the concept of sight and vision is mentioned in several Quranic verses, giving this name a spiritual and religious significance. Historically, Manzar has been used in Muslim cultures to describe places or things that are viewed with admiration or respect. The name Manzar carries a positive connotation, symbolizing a beautiful or inspiring view. It is used across various Muslim communities, reflecting a rich cultural and spiritual heritage.

data.cultural_impact: - In Persian culture, the term "manzar" (منظر) refers to a scene or a view. This term is often used in travel literature to describe the scenic beauty of various destinations, be it a mountainside, a body of water, or a cityscape. In Persian art, "manzars" are paintings that depict landscapes, miniatures, or cityscapes.
data.spiritual_significance: - In an Islamic context, the term "manzar" carries deeper spiritual significance. It can refer to the various perspectives and views of God that Muslims strive to gain throughout their spiritual journey. The term in this context is similar to Western concepts of "perspective," but with a focus on the significance of the Divine viewpoint.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Manzar means "view" or "scene" in Arabic. It symbolizes the idea of being a witness to the beauty and majesty of God's creation and the unfolding of His divine plan for our lives. A Manzar is one who observes the world with a spiritual perspective, recognizing the signs and signals from the Creator.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Battuta's Travels: Ibn Battuta describes Manzar-i-Jahangir as a magnificent garden in Lahore, Pakistan. The garden was commissioned by Mughal Emperor Jahangir for his wife, Nur Jahan, in 1606.
Al-Biruni's Chronology: Al-Biruni mentions a town called Manzarah in 1017, located in the Khwarazm region. Manzarah was an important trading center during the Middle Ages.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Manzar' has gained popularity in modern contexts, particularly in the technology, e-commerce, and education industries. On the technology platform Amazon, there is a popular conferencing solution, 'Amazon Chime', which has a feature named 'Manzar' that allows users to view all participants in a meeting at once. On the Google platform, 'Google Earth', there's a feature called 'Manzar View' that lets users explore 360-degree panoramic views of various places around the world. Lastly, on the education platform Coursera, there's a course titled 'Manzar-e-Adab' which offers a deep dive into Urdu literature and culture. Overall, the name 'Manzar' represents a comprehensive and panoramic view or understanding in these modern contexts.
